$comment: Accepted npm advisories: unfixable upstream with unreachable entry points in our usage. Every entry must name the GHSA id, the affected package, and why it is accepted. npm audit has no --ignore flag, so scripts/ci/npm_audit_check.mjs enforces this list (CI pipes `npm audit --json` into it); chain findings (via strings) inherit the verdict of their advisory root. Re-check entries when the dependency tree changes.

allow.reason: dev-chain transitive reaching the web workspace through the next/eslint tooling; build-time only, no runtime entry point for user-controlled glob patterns; re-check on the next eslint-config-next bump
